description: Synthetic boundary-condition polygons for Web Mercator coverage testing.  Includes polygons entirely within bounds, partially crossing the north and south limits, entirely outside bounds, and a split MultiPolygon spanning the antimeridian.  Features labelled 'dropped' lie entirely outside the Web Mercator extent and trigger a UserWarning.  Features labelled 'clipped' are passed to GDAL which clips them to the tile boundary internally.
